name: Salas de Bureba (Spain)
description: Quartered red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Salas de Bureba (a chequy field and a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Salas de Bureba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Salas de Bureba arms — chequy and castle
